arabic text:
KAR RAHA HAI YEH RAAWI BAYAAN KARBALA
USNE ASHOOR KI SHAB KA MANZAR LIKHA
SEENA E SHAH PA BINTE SHAHE HUDA
AUR SHABBIR KEHTE THE YEH BAARHA
HUMKO JAANA HAI KAL KARNE WAADA WAFA
TUMPE AAJAEGA SABR KA MARHALA
BAAT SAARI SAKINA NE SHEH KI SUNI
AUR JAWABAN WHO BAS ITNA KEHTI RAHI
english translation text:
The narrator describes Karbala
and writes the scene of Ashura night:
the daughter of the King of guidance lay upon the King's chest,
while Shabbir repeatedly said:
Tomorrow I must go and fulfil my promise;
you will then face the stage of patience.
Sakina heard everything the King said,
and in reply she repeated only this:

arabic text: ACHA BABA SULAANE TO AAWOGE NA\nROZ CHEHRA DIKHANE TO AAWOGE NA
english translation text: All right, Baba—but you will come to put me to sleep, won't you?\nYou will show me your face every day, won't you?

arabic text:
BOLE SHABBIR AY MERI NOOR E NAZAR
TUMKO KARNA HAI AB SHAAM TAK KA SAFAR
TUMKO QAIDI BANAENGE AB EHLE SHAR
BOLI SHAHZADI MUJHKO NAHI KOI DAR
TUM KAHO TUM SULAANE TO AAWOGE NA
ROZ CHEHRA DIKHANE TO AAWOGE NA
english translation text:
Shabbir said: O light of my eyes,
you must now travel all the way to Shaam.
The wicked will make you a captive.
The princess replied: I am not afraid;
just tell me—you will come to put me to sleep, won't you?
You will show me your face every day, won't you?

arabic text:
SHAH KEHNE LAGE AY MERI LAADLI
TUMPE AAEGI AB SHAAM E GHAM KI GHARI
AAG DAAMAN ME HOGI TUMHARE LAGI
BOLI WHO FIKR MUJHKO NAHI HAI KOI
MERA DAAMAN BUJHAANE TO AAWOGE NA
ROZ CHEHRA DIKHANE TO AAWOGE NA
english translation text:
The King said: O my beloved daughter,
the sorrowful evening will soon descend upon you.
Your garment will catch fire.
She replied: I am not worried;
you will come to extinguish my garment, won't you?
You will show me your face every day, won't you?

arabic text:
MUSTARIB DIL SE KEHNE LAGE SHAHE DEEN
TERI QISMAT ME BETI SUKOON AB NAHI
AB TAMACHE LAGAAEGA SHIMR E LAEEN
SUNKE YEH BAAT KEHNE LAGI WHO HAZEEN
english translation text:
With a distressed heart, the King of the faith said:
my daughter, peace is no longer written in your destiny.
The accursed Shimr will now strike you with slaps.
Hearing this, the grieving child began to say:

arabic text: SHIMR SE TUM BACHAANE TO AAWOGE NA\nROZ CHEHRA DIKHANE TO AAWOGE NA
english translation text: You will come to save me from Shimr, won't you?\nYou will show me your face every day, won't you?

arabic text:
PHIR KIYA SHEH NE BETI SE KUCH YOON SUKHAN
SAB HARAM HONGE AB TO ASEER E MAHAN
TERE HAATHON ME BHI AB BANDHEGI RASAN
BOLI YEH BAAT SUNKE WHO TASHNA DAHAN
TUM GALE SE LAGAANE TO AAWOGE NA
ROZ CHEHRA DIKHANE TO AAWOGE NA
english translation text:
Then the King spoke to his daughter again:
all the sacred ladies will become captives of sorrow.
Ropes will be tied around your hands too.
Hearing this, the thirsty child replied:
you will come to hold me to your chest, won't you?
You will show me your face every day, won't you?

arabic text:
ROKE SHABBIR NE USKE BOSE LIYE
BOLE RUKHSAAR BHI HONGE ZAKHMI TERE
TERE RONE KE SHAHZAADI DIN AAGAYE
BOLI TUM KAISE DEKHOGE ROTE HUWE
HAAN MUJHE CHUP KARAANE TO AAWOGE NA
ROZ CHEHRA DIKHANE TO AAWOGE NA
english translation text:
Weeping, Shabbir kissed her and said:
your cheeks too will be wounded.
The days of your weeping have arrived, O princess.
She said: how will you bear to see me cry?
You will come to comfort me, won't you?
You will show me your face every day, won't you?

arabic text:
BARHTI JAATI THI BECHAYNI SHABBIR KI
HAR SITAM WHO UTHAANE PE RAAZI HUWI
ZINDA BABA NA HONGE SAMAJH NA SAKI
SUNKE SAB MUSHKILE BAS YEH KEHTI RAHI
GAR ME RUTHI MANANE TO AAWOGE NA
ROZ CHEHRA DIKHANE TO AAWOGE NA
english translation text:
Shabbir's restlessness continued to grow.
She accepted every hardship that would come,
yet could not understand that Baba would no longer be alive.
Hearing every difficulty, she only kept saying:
if I become upset, you will come to persuade me, won't you?
You will show me your face every day, won't you?

arabic text:
LIKH KE SALMAN DIL PHAT RAHA HAI MERA
ZAIN JAB SHAAHE WALA NO ROKAR KAHA
AB TO ZINDAAN MARQAD BANEGA TERA
BETI SAABIR KI THI BOLI WHO SAABIRA
MERA LAASHA UTHAANE TO AAWOGE NA
ROZ CHEHRA DIKHANE TO AAWOGE NA
english translation text:
O Salman, my heart is breaking as I write this.
When the exalted King wept and said:
this prison will now become your grave,
the patient daughter of the patient one replied:
you will come to lift my body, won't you?
You will show me your face every day, won't you?
